company.name: Instana
company.shortDescription: Enterprise observability platform for modern Dev+Ops cloud-native microservices Application Performance Monitoring
company.description: Instana discovers and maps services, infrastructure and full-stack interdependencies automatically in realtime, delivering context and feedback needed for modern cloud-native microservices Application Performance Monitoring (APM). Instana offers a comprehensive enterprise observability platform: it ingests all observability metrics, traces each request and profiles every process. Instana provides actionable contextual information empowering Dev+Ops teams to manage and optimize their delivery pipelines, application quality, system availability and performance.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $30,000,000, or 52.63% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $27,943,121 to $188,148,597, a 6.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 43 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 35 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
